summary: Frontend-only UI test of the premium-redesigned Welcome screen in the partner Expo web export served at /pp/. At 390x844 all required testIDs are present (welcome-screen, app-brand-logo, welcome-language-btn, welcome-title, welcome-hero, welcome-trust-{verified,fast,affordable}, get-started-card, welcome-login-btn, welcome-register-btn, welcome-security-note). No horizontal overflow (sw=cw=390). Hero image bbox x=203..390 vs title bbox x=20..195 — no overlap with subtitle. Language pill opens dropdown with welcome-language-en; tapping English closes it; welcome-language-backdrop also closes it. welcome-login-btn → /pp/login, welcome-register-btn → /pp/register. Desktop 1920x800: no horizontal overflow (sw=cw=1920), CTA fully in view (y=615, h=66). Fallback brand logo (A mark + AzoApp wordmark + 'Service at Your Door Steps' tagline) shown as expected since admin logo is not configured in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: welcome.tsx BrandLogo gracefully handles missing admin logo (uri='') by rendering fallback immediately — good. onLoad reads e.source.width/height which is expo-image-specific; keep an eye out if ever ported to RN Image.
Modal animationType='none' with manual Animated.timing on opacity works, but there is no exit animation — dropdown disappears instantly on close. Minor polish opportunity.
useNativeDriver warning in web is harmless (no RCTAnimation on web); non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview partner web export lives at https://partner-work-queue.preview.emergentagent.com/pp/index.html (baseUrl /pp). To route to any screen use history.pushState + popstate dispatch after waiting ~6s for the Expo bundle to boot. Admin branding (logo_light/logo/logo_dark) is empty in this preview so the AzoApp text fallback is rendered — this is expected, not a bug.
